business_scope.primary_industry_name: Manufacture of Urban Electric Cargo Bicycles and Step-Through Scooters

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (national unitary jurisdiction; no sub-state corporate tax differentiation)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (codified commercial law under Código de Comercio, Decree-Law 410 of 1971; modern SAS regime under Law 1258 of 2008; arbitration-friendly)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia–United States Trade Promotion Agreement (TPA), in force since 15 May 2012, with Chapter 10 investment protections
Colombia–European Union Trade Agreement, in force since 11 December 2013, with investment liberalization and investor-state provisions
Colombia–United Kingdom Trade Continuity Agreement, in force since 1 January 2021
Pacific Alliance Framework Agreement (Alianza del Pacífico) among Colombia, Chile, Mexico and Peru, in force since 2016
Colombia–Spain Bilateral Investment Treaty, in force since 2007, and Colombia–Spain Double Taxation Agreement, in force since 2008
Colombia–Switzerland Bilateral Investment Treaty, in force since 2010

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Primary statutory framework: Law 526 of 1999 (creates the UIAF); Law 1121 of 2006 (AML/CFT criminal and preventive framework); Law 1762 of 2015 (instruments to prevent and sanction money laundering, terrorist financing and contraband); Law 2195 of 2022 (anti-corruption and transparency reform mandating the ultimate-beneficial-owner registry); Decree 2495 of 2023 (regulates the Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales 'RUBF' by amending Decree 1068 of 2015); Law 1258 of 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada regime); Código de Comercio (Decree-Law 410 of 1971, arts. 110 and 350–355 on commercial registration). The RUBF defines a final beneficiary as any natural person who directly or indirectly holds, controls, or receives more than 5% of the capital, voting rights or profits, or who exercises de facto control per Law 222 of 1995, art. 26.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access. The RUBF database is accessible exclusively by the UIAF, DIAN, the Superintendencia de Sociedades, and authorized criminal/anti-corruption enforcement authorities; it is not open to public inspection and is not available to commercial credit bureaus. Nominee or indirect holding structures are permissible only if the natural-person UBO is fully disclosed to the UIAF through the RUBF portal.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney (Poder General o Especial) executed by each foreign shareholder appointing the Colombian incorporator/legal representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or equivalent competent civil-law officer in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Convention of 5 October 1961); consular legalization only for signatory states to the Convention in non-participating foreign jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport or national identity document of each foreign shareholder and of each UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent registry in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing for any legal-person shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company registry of the shareholder's jurisdiction (e.g., Companies House, Secretary of State, commercial register)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO sworn declaration (Declaración Jurada de Beneficiario Final) with the full ownership chain and percentages, incorporated into the SAS deed
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Colombian notary public before whom the deed or private document is executed
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Local Colombian notarial authentication; subsequent online filing in the UIAF RUBF portal (no apostille required)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of tax residence (Certificado de Residencia Fiscal) for corporate shareholders if treaty relief under a DTAA is intended
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Tax authority of the shareholder's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization if the issuing state is not party to the Apostille Convention

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all shareholders, statutory representatives and UBOs against: (i) the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List; (ii) the UN Security Council Consolidated Sanctions List; (iii) the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List as applied by correspondent banks in USD/EUR clearing; (iv) Colombian domestic asset-freeze and terrorism designations issued by the Consejo de Seguridad Nacional, the Fiscalía General de la Nación and the UIAF; (v) Interpol Red Notices and diffusions; (vi) PEP databases and political-exposure indicators derived from UIAF guidance and the Superintendencia Financiera's Circular Básica Jurídica, Part I Title III; and (vii) FATF and GAFILAT high-risk jurisdiction lists. Any positive match, negative-media hit, or unexplained PEP link requires enhanced due diligence and a documented compliance clearance before the deed is notarized.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Ventanilla Única Empresarial (VUE) and Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES) — www.rues.org.co — operated by the local Cámara de Comercio (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá, CCB) with administrative supervision of the Superintendencia de Sociedades
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered corporate name must be expressed in Spanish and in Latin-script characters; distinctive denominative elements may include foreign-language words provided they are written in the Latin alphabet and do not mislead regarding the legal form or activity. The statutory suffix 'S.A.S.' or the extended expression 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada' is mandatory in the certificate of existence, the bylaws and all official letterheads. Accents and special Spanish orthographic marks are preserved in the RUES official record.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: BANCO / BANK / FINANCIERA / COMPAÑÍA DE FINANCIAMIENTO / SEGUROS / FONDOS / HOLDING FINANCIERO — require prior authorization of the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia
COOPERATIVA / SOLIDARIA / ENTIDAD DE ECONOMÍA SOLIDARIA — reserved to entities previously authorized by the Superintendencia de la Economía Solidaria
BENEFICIO E INTERÉS COLECTIVO (SOCIEDAD BIC) — available only to an S.A.S. that expressly elects the Law 1901 of 2018 BIC regime in its bylaws
REPÚBLICA / NACIONAL / PRESIDENCIA / MINISTERIO / GOBERNACIÓN / ALCALDÍA / INSTITUTO OFICIAL — expressions suggesting public or governmental character are prohibited or strictly conditioned

COLOMBIA / COLOMBIANA / BOGOTÁ — permitted only when not identical or deceptively similar to existing public entities, regulatory marks or registered names, and subject to the chamber's anti-confusion review
FUNDACIÓN / FUNDACIÓN DE UTILIDAD PÚBLICA — reserved for nonprofit legal forms under Colombian law and cannot be used by a commercial S.A.S.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: In the event of a name-rejection notification (homonymy conflict, prohibited token, or confusing similarity), the applicant may within 10 working days from notification file a recurso de reposición before the issuing Cámara de Comercio under Law 1437 of 2011 (CPACA) as amended by Law 2080 of 2021; if the reposición is denied, a recurso de apelación may be filed within the following 10 working days before the Superintendencia de Sociedades (Delegatura de Procedimientos Mercantiles). In parallel, the applicant may submit an alternative name clearance request that incorporates a distinctive differentiating element (elemento diferenciador), such as a unique coined word, trademark or geographic qualifier, in the RUES system. A rejected name cannot be reserved or used; official clearance is evidenced by the Chamber's homonymy/name-approval certificate recorded in the RUES.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A recognized business-center or serviced-address virtual office is accepted for the SAS statutory domicile and for DIAN/RUES notification purposes, provided the provider maintains an operable physical address in the municipality where the domicile is declared and attends receipt of judicial and administrative notices. A virtual office does not, however, satisfy functional manufacturing substance: the electric cargo-bike assembly and warehousing operations require a separate industrial premises approved under municipal uso del suelo (land-use) regulation. The RUT and the Chamber registration must state the exact real address of the operating plant.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Medium-to-high for manufacturing taxpayers: approximately 30% probability of an unannounced DIAN on-site visit within the first 12 months of operation, increasing to 45–55% if the company claims VAT refunds, zero-rated export treatment, or free-zone benefits. Additional inspections may be conducted by municipal industrial/commercial authorities (uso del suelo), the environmental authority (if painting/welding/battery integration is present), and the labor ministry (SGSST occupational-health and safety compliance).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and homonymy certificate (Certificado de Homonimia) at the local Cámara de Comercio
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the domicile municipality

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of signatures on the incorporation private document and UBO sworn declaration

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada) as amended; Código de Comercio, arts. 98-110, 359 and 372-375; Decreto Único Reglamentario 1074 de 2015, Title 2, Chapter 1 (reglamento del Registro Mercantil).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá, Registro Único Empresarial (RUE) / Ventanilla Única Empresarial; integrated with the DIAN tax registry for post-formation RUT issuance.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento privado de constitución with authenticated shareholder signatures, filed for inscription in the Registro Mercantil.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No legal minimum paid-up capital is required for an S.A.S. under Ley 1258 de 2008. The by-laws may set any capital amount, in any currency, and payment may be deferred up to two years, unless the by-laws specify a shorter term. No escrow deposit is required for incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the founders' subscription of 1,000 ordinary shares, nominal value COP 1,000 each, is accepted and issued to the subscribing shareholders, reflecting the initial paid-in capital recorded in the incorporation document. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office for statutory and legal notices is established at [Calle Example #12-34], Bogotá D.C., and is designated as the principal establishment for all corporate, tax, and judicial purposes. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the shareholders appoint [Name] as Legal Representative, [Name] as Secretary, and [Name] as Fiscal Auditor, when required by law, granting the Legal Representative broad powers under Article 20 of Ley 1258 de 2008. RESOLVED FINALLY, that the Representative is authorized to perform post-incorporation registrations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá - Registro Único Empresarial (RUE) online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the RUE platform and select 'Constitución de Sociedades'. Request a certificate of name availability ('Certificado de Homonimia') to confirm that the proposed corporate name 'CO_SAS ELECTRIC CARGO EBIKE MFG' is not identical to an existing trade name or company in the chamber's registry. Reserve the approved name for 30 calendar days and retain the reservation code for the incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Certificate of name availability / homonimia
Scanned identity document of each founding shareholder (cédula for residents, passport for non-residents)
Email and telephone contact data of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chosen name is rejected due to similarity, submit a written rectification through the RUE portal proposing two alternative names. If the rejection persists, appeal with supporting evidence of legitimate interest within 10 business days before the Cámara de Comercio's registry review unit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and execute the S.A.S. incorporation instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (for signature authentication) or Cámara de Comercio - Sociedades en Línea platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the private incorporation document in Spanish, containing the corporate purpose, term, registered office address, share structure, paid-in and deferred capital, representation rules, audit clauses, and the rights and obligations of shareholders. Ensure that the full legal name and identification numbers of all shareholders and the legal representative are correctly stated. All signatures must be authenticated before a notary or by certified digital signatures issued by an authorized certification authority.
required_dossiers: Draft private incorporation document under Ley 1258 de 2008
Notarial authentication of shareholder and legal representative signatures
Pre-RUT registration data obtained from DIAN
Passport or cédula of each signatory
Foreign shareholder tax identification number or NIT, if already assigned
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Cámara de Comercio identifies omissions in the incorporation document, correct the deficiencies by filing an amending letter ('subsanación' / 'aclaración') through the same online portal and re-authenticate any modified signature page. The process must be completed within 30 calendar days to avoid losing the name reservation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File the incorporation document and obtain the Chamber of Commerce registration certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá - Registro Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the authenticated incorporation document together with the payment of the registry tariff through the RUE portal or at the local chamber window. The chamber verifies legal compliance, assigns the company's 9-digit NIT temporary number, and issues the 'Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal' (Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation) upon successful registration.
required_dossiers: Authenticated incorporation document
Certificate of name availability / homonimia
DIAN pre-RUT form
Receipt of payment of chamber registration fees
Proof of registered office (lease title, public service bill or landlord authorization)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the chamber issues a 'requerimiento', file the requested additional documentation within the legal term (generally 10 business days) using the RUE portal. If the certificate is not issued due to unresolved observations, present a formal reconsideration petition to the chamber's registry department and obtain a written explanation with the specific legal grounds.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete DIAN registration, obtain RUT and configure electronic invoicing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the Chamber certificate, access the DIAN portal and complete the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) with company identification, legal representative data, corporate purpose, and address. Request the activation of the 'Régimen Común' status and electronic invoicing authorization (Resolución de Facturación). Define all applicable taxes, including national income tax, VAT, ICA (industry and commerce tax), and withholdings. Generate the digital signature certificate through the DIAN-authorized certification provider.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal issued by Cámara de Comercio
Pre-RUT data and company connection fact
Legal representative's passport or cédula
Proof of registered office address
Corporate email address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the RUT application, verify the tax obligation codes and correct any discrepancies in the company's address or legal representative data through the DIAN online portal. If the rejection is based on an administrative inconsistency, file an electronic response to the 'requerimiento' and resubmit the application; if necessary, request an in-person appointment at the DIAN customer service office.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the company as an employer with social security, occupational risk and payroll system
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Administradoras de Riesgos Laborales (ARL), EPS, AFP and PILA operating operator
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Using the company RUT, register the legal representative and, if applicable, the initial employees as contributors in the integrated social security system (PILA). Select an ARL class for manufacturing activity according to the hazards of electric cargo bicycle assembly, obtain the employer registration number, and prepare the payroll file for future pension, health and work-risk contributions.
required_dossiers: Company RUT
Legal representative's identity document
RUT of each employee
Company economic activity classification (ISIC 3091)
Basic payroll information
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the PILA operator rejects the employer registration, correct the RUT classification or legal representative data and re-submit the registration through a different operator or directly with the AFP/EPS/ARL selected. Retain all affiliation receipts as evidence of timely compliance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open corporate bank account and activate international payment rails
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank with corporate treasury and trade finance desks
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the final corporate registration certificate, RUT, board resolution appointing the legal representative and authorized signatories, and the company's AML/KYC information. Request a standard low-risk corporate account with capability for SWIFT wire transfers, letters of credit issuance and T/T incoming/outgoing payments for the micro-mobility OEM business.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Company RUT
Notarized board resolution appointing legal representative and signatories
Passport or cédula of the legal representative
Proof of registered office
Beneficial ownership and source-of-funds declaration forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests additional beneficial ownership information, submit a written ownership chain statement supported by the company's share ledger and statutory documents. If the account application is declined or frozen, request a formal compliance explanation and, if necessary, reapply with a different licensed financial institution providing more complete transactional documents.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente of Bogotá D.C. and the local Alcaldía Municipal for land-use and industrial activity registration; Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) for product conformity and consumer safety compliance.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Certificado de Uso de Suelo / Registro de Actividad Industrial y Matrícula de Industria y Comercio (ICA)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) and the applicable Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) / Secretaría Distrital de Ambiente
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 - Full EIA not required; mandatory environmental registration and waste-manifesto compliance for light manufacturing/assembly operations conducting battery integration and limited painting or coating activities.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges must comply with Resolución 0631 de 2015 for industrial non-domestic discharges; atmospheric emissions and VOCs limited by Resolución 2254 de 2017; hazardous waste management, transport and disposal must comply with Decreto 4741 de 2005; lithium-ion battery waste and scrap must be tracked under the extended producer responsibility and RESPEL information system.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate issued by the Cuerpo de Bomberos through the Oficina de Prevención de Incendios; structural load inspection for factory racking and battery storage areas; occupational risk prevention plan registered with the ARL; and workplace inspection certificate (Certificado de Condiciones Sanitarias) from the Secretaría Distrital de Salud where assembly and storage activities are conducted.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Unidad Administrativa Especial Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) — official portal: www.dian.gov.co; electronic taxpayer services (Oficina Virtual, Muisca, RUT pre-registration and e-invoicing systems) are accessed through sede.dian.gov.co and the 'Sede Electrónica DIAN'.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign founders of a Colombian S.A.S. must (1) execute the private deed of incorporation before a notary and register it with the competent Cámara de Comercio (Chamber of Commerce) obtaining the certificate of existence and legal representation; (2) obtain a local fiscal address and appoint a legal representative resident in Colombia; (3) complete DIAN's online 'Pre-RUT' and 'Pre-NIT' registration, which requires the chamber of commerce certificate, the corporate document, the identification documents of directors/legal representatives, and evidence of fiscal domicile; (4) undergo DIAN biometric verification and digital signature ('firma electrónica') enrollment to obtain the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria); and (5) finalize the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) with the applicable CIIU codes for ISIC 3091 (CIIU 3091) and tax responsibilities for corporate income tax, VAT, self-withholdings, and exporter status. The RUT is mandatory for the SAS to issue electronic invoices and carry out customs operations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation (the S.A.S. is a separate juridical person taxed as a Colombian resident company on worldwide income; Colombian law does not authorize partnership-style pass-through treatment for an S.A.S.; non-resident shareholders are subject to dividend withholding tax on distributed profits, with possible reduction under applicable tax treaties).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia has no 'check-the-box' election. Available statutory mechanisms in the defined context: (a) election by a qualifying parent/holding company for the 'Régimen de Compañías Holding Colombianas (CINCE)' under Law 2277 of 2022 and Decree 1325 of 2023, which exempts dividends received from foreign subsidiaries and capital gains on indirect disposals; (b) election for 'Usuario Zona Franca' status (decree 2147/2016) in an authorized Free Trade Zone, yielding a 20% corporate income tax rate and special customs treatment for export-oriented manufacturing; (c) election by entities carrying out only export services to claim 'exporter' VAT status in the RUT; and (d) hybrid-mismatch election rules are not elective in Colombia — E.T. Article 130-1 and related provisions apply against deduction/non-inclusion mismatches automatically, not through an affirmative election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT (Impuesto sobre las Ventas – IVA), governed by the Estatuto Tributario (E.T.) — use IVA 19% general rate and the applicable CIIU 3091 characterization.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general turnover threshold applies to SAS legal entities: any company performing taxable IVA activities in Colombian territory is obligated to register with DIAN as an 'Responsable del Régimen Común' from the date of corporate activation, irrespective of revenue level. The 'Régimen Simplificado' exclusion is reserved for natural persons meeting restrictive conditions (income below approximately COP 164.7 million (3,500 UVT for 2024), gross assets below COP 150 million, and non-import/export activity), so an electric cargo e-bike manufacturer cannot rely on de minimis exemption.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All VAT-responsible S.A.S. taxpayers must issue a 'Factura Electrónica de Venta (FEV)' using UBL 2.1 XML signed with the taxpayer's digital certificate and transmit it to DIAN in real time for validation and legal clearance either through DIAN's free 'Facturador Electrónico DIAN' or an authorized service provider (FSE/TSP). Once validated, DIAN assigns a unique CUNE (Código Único de Numeración), and the invoice must present a QR code and be issued in a PDF/A-2.1 representation as required by Decree 2242/2015 and later amendments. This mandate applies to issuing 'notas crédito/débito', 'documento soporte en adquisiciones', and 'remisiones' and requires filing of the daily 'Información Exógena' (population registers of sales/purchases) with DIAN.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods (including electric cargo bicycles under CIIU 3091) are zero-rated for VAT pursuant to E.T. Articles 481 and 482, provided the exporter holds the 'Exportador' classification in the RUT, invoicing reflects a foreign buyer, the goods physically leave Colombia as declared, and shipment occurs within the statutory term (generally 90 days from the invoice date, extendable by DIAN in justified cases). Provision of services strictly related to the export process (international cargo transit, customs logistics, and services used or consumed exclusively abroad by foreign recipients) may also qualify for zero-rating when formalized with a clear export service contract and foreign currency payment. The manufacturer must simultaneously submit the export declaration (DEX) through DIAN's 'VUCE'/'SIGMA' platform and retain evidence of the physical shipment.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación – DEX/DUE) accepted by DIAN customs office (with physical exit verified)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / Cargo Manifest evidencing international shipment
Commercial invoice coherent with the electronically transmitted FEV (including amount, parties, Incoterms 2020 terms)
Packing list and certificate of origin (where applicable to bilateral trade preferences)
Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Negocio de Cambio) or SWIFT/telegraphic transfer confirmation proving receipt of export proceeds in Colombia
Proof of RUT 'Exportador' status and, if applicable, free-zone user authorization
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN's fiscal control division will scrutinize documentation consistency, CUNE-valid invoices, DEX filing, transportation terms, and the physical exit of goods. Failure to meet the shipping window (90 days, unless extended) converts the zero-rating into a 19% VAT obligation retroactively, generating value-added tax, daily moratory interest, and the ‘sanción por inexactitud’ (up to 100% of the omitted tax, increased to 200% when fraudulent misrepresentation is established). If the manufacturer claims a refund of prior export VAT credits and the DEX is subsequently annulled or the shipment is not properly validated, DIAN orders retrospective clawback of the refunded amounts plus interest and penalties, may impose ‘sanción por devolución y/o compensación improcedente’ (usually 20% of the improperly refunded amount), and may refer the case for criminal tax fraud prosecution under Law 1819/2016 (punishable for aggravated fraudulent export procedures).

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República de Colombia (Junta Directiva), the sole monetary and exchange-rate authority, governs the foreign-exchange regime through Resolución Externa No. 1 of 2018 (as amended, including Decreto 1194 of 2023) and implementing Circular Reglamentaria DCIN-83; the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia (SFC) supervises all Intermediarios del Mercado Cambiario (IMC) authorized to execute regulated FX operations, while the DIAN enforces customs, import/export, and tax declaration integration with cross-border flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Colombian peso (COP) operates under a managed-float (dirty float) regime with full current-account convertibility covering goods, services, and profit remittances, conditional on mandatory channeling through an IMC. Capital-account transactions (FDI, foreign loans) are free but must be channeled via an IMC and registered with the Banco de la República when cumulative direct investment equals or exceeds USD 500,000 in order to preserve dividend-remittance and capital-repatriation guarantees. Dividend remittances to non-resident shareholders require proof of payment or certification of colombian corporate income tax, execution of the Declaración de Cambio through the remitting IMC, and settlement of the 10% non-resident dividend withholding (subject to treaty relief); no pre-approval is required and no fixed percentage conversion quota exists.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: One hundred percent (100%) of goods-export proceeds must be channeled (canalizadas) through the regulated foreign-exchange market within the statutory term: 6 months from shipment date under the baseline rule of Resolución Externa 1/2018, Art. 96, extended to 13 months for goods exports by Decreto 1194 of 2023. The exporter must elect one of three compliant routes: (i) sell the foreign currency to an IMC at the prevailing TRM, (ii) credit the proceeds to a locally held foreign-currency compensation account (cuenta de compensación) opened with an IMC, or (iii) credit an eligible offshore account under the compensation regime; deductible expenses (freight, insurance, export financing) are excluded from the channelable amount, and all compensation accounts are subject to quarterly reporting to the Banco de la República under Circular DCIN-83.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Subscription Escrow Account (Cuenta de Aportes); Operational Current Account (Cuenta Corriente COP); Foreign-Currency Compensation Account (Cuenta de Compensación USD)
Capital Subscription Escrow Account (Cuenta de Aportes); Operational Current Account (Cuenta Corriente COP); Foreign-Currency Compensation Account (Cuenta de Compensación USD)

Capital Subscription Escrow Account (Cuenta de Aportes); Operational Current Account (Cuenta Corriente COP); Foreign-Currency Compensation Account (Cuenta de Compensación USD)
Operational Current Account (Cuenta Corriente COP); Foreign-Currency Compensation Account (Cuenta de Compensación USD)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW as the sole treasury or FX-clearing channel; MEDIUM as an ancillary expense-card utility. Legal constraints: Colombia's FX regime (Resolución Externa 1/2018) requires all exchange-market transactions, including export-proceeds channeling, import payments, FDI inflows, and dividend remittances, to be routed exclusively through SFC-supervised IMCs. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex, Revolut Business, Mercury) are not licensed as IMCs, cannot issue COP accounts, cannot connect to the domestic clearing system (ACH/CENIT), and cannot fulfill DIAN tax payments; interposing an EMI in any FX-market transaction triggers SFC administrative sanctions, potential criminal FX exposure, and DIAN transfer-pricing recharacterization. EMIs are therefore limited to immaterial operating purchases (software subscriptions, digital advertising) and must be reconciled back to the IMC channel in the company's books.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory appearance: at least one legal representative holding notarized, apostilled, and Cámara de Comercio-registered powers must physically attend the onboarding interview at a designated main branch (Bogotá, Medellín, or Barranquilla) to execute the account contract and the KYC fact-verification form (formulario de vinculación). Remote digital onboarding exists only where the bank operates an SFC-approved biometric verification platform and is generally reserved for resident individuals or established customers; for a newly incorporated, foreign-owned S.A.S., in-person attendance remains de facto mandatory. Non-resident directors may delegate to a locally appointed officer through a Colombian-consulate notarized power of attorney, with an interview by video-conference permitted only in exceptional, bank-approved cases.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity: foreign shareholders resident in high-risk or low-tax jurisdictions without visible economic nexus
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete UBO tree per SFC Circular Básica Jurídica and FATF recommendations; apostilled constitutional documents (estatutos), share ledger (libro de registro de accionistas), tax-residence certificates, group organizational chart, and a written commercial rationale describing the Colombian SAS as the Latin American manufacturing and distribution platform for electric cargo bikes and step-through scooters.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid post-incorporation capital injections disproportionate to payroll and physical operating footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source-of-funds bundle: investor bank statements, executed share-subscription minutes, capital-payment receipts, notarized declaration of source of funds (declaración de origen de fondos), and the capex/import budget (tooling molds, Li-ion battery cells, electric controllers, CKD kits) aligned with the e-bike manufacturing build-out.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value third-party trade payments to Asian component suppliers flagged as trade-based money-laundering risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete trade dossier: pro-forma invoices, original Bills of Lading, packing lists, DIAN import declarations (declaración de importación), SICEX records, letter-of-credit (MT700) documentation, freight contracts, and an OECD-standard transfer-pricing policy supporting intercompany and third-party component purchases.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Export-model red flag: receivables collected through intermediaries or payability diverted from the Colombian exporter bank account
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed sales contracts with foreign distributors, delivery certificates (actas de entrega), collection records, buyer KYC documentation, and a written receivable-financing policy demonstrating that export collections flow directly into the IMC account for statutory channeling within the 13-month window.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: (1) the foreign investor executes a SWIFT MT103 credit transfer to the CO_SAS capital-subscription escrow account or COP operational account held at a Tier-1 IMC, citing in the payment memo the beneficiary NIT (NIT of the Colombian SAS) and the Banco de la República foreign-investment purpose code 'Inversión Directa Internacional – Aporte de Capital'. (2) The IMC files the foreign-exchange declaration (Declaración de Cambio, Form 4) at value date, identifying the transaction as a direct capital contribution. (3) Registration in the Registro de Inversiones Internacionales is mandatory when cumulative FDI reaches USD 500,000; voluntary registration below that threshold is recommended to secure future dividend-remittance and capital-repatriation rights. (4) Funds must remain in the escrow account until the share-subscription minutes are registered with the Cámara de Comercio and the equity contribution is formalized in the S.A.S. books within the statutory capital-payment window, after which the balance is swept to the operational account. (5) No prior exchange-control authorization is required, but the IMC may request the underlying subscription minutes, board resolutions, and evidence of the investor's legal existence before releasing funds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Treasury clearing rails: (i) TT/Wire: SWIFT MT103 via a domestic IMC for advance payments, milestone payments, and low-value component settlements; each disbursement is matched to the corresponding DIAN import declaration and reported through the Declaración de Cambio for goods-import payments. (ii) Commercial Letters of Credit: irrevocable sight or usance LCs issued by the Tier-1 bank (MT700) under UCP600 for high-value recurring purchases (battery packs, electric drive systems, frames), settled via SWIFT MT202/MT103 upon presentation of complying shipping documents. (iii) Export receivables: inbound settlements from foreign e-bike distributors under LC or documentary collections must be credited to the IMC compensation account and channeled within the 13-month window; direct USD-denominated supplier payments from the compensation account are permitted for operating imports without conversion to COP, subject to quarterly Banco de la República reporting.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: COP/USD deliverable spot and outright forwards booked through IMCs with physical settlement in COP at the TRM reference rate
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) with offshore counterparties where local deliverable forward pricing is uncompetitive
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) for long-term USD capex debt, asset-liability matching, and foreign-investment hedging
COP/USD FX options (calls and puts) for premium-bounded hedge programs with defined downside protection
TRM-indexed futures and forward contracts listed on the Bolsa de Valores de Colombia (BVC) under MILA clearing rules

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (Annual Mercantile Registry Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the municipality of the registered corporate seat
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between 1 January and 31 March for the preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal surcharge of 50% of the renewal tariff plus moratory interest if paid after 31 March; two consecutive non-renewals permit cancellation of the mercantile registration and administrative dissolution of the SAS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Declaración de Renta y Complementarios (Annual Corporate Income Tax Return)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in April of the following fiscal year; the exact date is published by DIAN Resolution according to the last digit of the NIT, generally between 9 and 21 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 5% of the tax due per month or fraction of month (capped at 100%) plus moratory interest at 1.5 times the bank consumer-loan rate; persistent default exposes the SAS to coercive collection and forced liquidation proceedings by DIAN.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Estados Financieros de Fin de Ejercicio (Annual Financial Statements filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered corporate seat (filed with the annual mercantile renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March for the fiscal year ended 31 December
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file blocks the mercantile registry renewal, triggering the 50% late-renewal surcharge and loss of evidentiary value of the statutory books in commercial and tax proceedings.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory tax holiday. Authorized Zona Franca permanent industrial users benefit from a 25% corporate income tax rate. Deductions for 100% of VAT paid on productive fixed assets, accelerated depreciation on fixed productive assets, and the 25% tax credit for investments in science, technology, and innovation are available subject to DIAN rules and economic substance verification.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 210 (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios) filed electronically through the DIAN MUISCA portal using a pre-validated XML and the taxpayer's electronic signature.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return for fiscal year-end 31 December must be filed between early March and late April of the following year, depending strictly on the last digit of the taxpayer's NIT as published by DIAN in the annual filing calendar. Non-resident-owned S.A.S. entities must follow the same calendar and cannot defer for foreign shareholder approval reasons.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax identification number assigned by DIAN for the S.A.S. entity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Colombian NIT exactly as registered; a foreign entity cannot substitute its home tax ID.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Aggregate gross income from sale of electric cargo bicycles, spare parts, assemblies, and services during the tax year before deductions or cost allocation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include all Colombian-source revenue and, if tax resident in Colombia, worldwide revenue. Sales to foreign related distributors must be stated at arm's length.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Sales returns, allowances, trade discounts, and similar reductions of gross income actually granted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Substantiate with commercial invoices and credit notes; discounted intercompany transactions require transfer pricing support.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 13 / Ingresos no constitutivos de renta
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Items excluded from taxable income, such as capital reimbursements, certain dividends received, or bookkeeping reclassifications recognized by law.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Restrict this line to clear statutory exclusions; unsupported exclusions trigger a 100% inexactness penalty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Direct costs of manufacturing e-bikes: materials, imported components, labor, factory overhead, and depreciation on productive assets.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Import costs from related suppliers must be documented under transfer pricing rules; no deduction for undocumented invoicing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating expenses not capitalized, including factory rent, logistics, salaries, insurance, utilities, SAT testing, administrative expenses, and statutory depreciation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses paid to foreign affiliates require evidence of actual service, withholding compliance, and arm's length charge.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net ordinary taxable income after gross income less returns, non-taxable income, costs, and deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Carryforward losses may reduce this balance only after satisfying the 12-year and annual offset limitations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax losses of previous years actually claimed as an offset against current net ordinary income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders cannot claim these losses directly; the S.A.S. must maintain a history of audited tax returns proving the loss year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable amount after applying tax exemptions and loss compensation; this is the base for the 35% corporate rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify Form 210 calculation, including the 35% tariff and any Zona Franca preferential rate if applicable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Preliminary corporate income tax computed at the statutory rate on taxable net income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For ordinary S.A.S., apply 35%; for qualified Zona Franca user, apply 25% and attach the DIAN authorization.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax credits, such as the 25% credit for qualified science, technology, and innovation investments, donations, and other statutory allowances.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only statutory credits with formal technical certificate acceptable; intercompany-generated credits will be challenged.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final income tax liability after tax credits and prepayments, before payments made during the fiscal year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This amount must match the total paid through bank remittance to DIAN; foreign shareholders cannot receive a distribution until this liability is settled.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of Form 210 triggers the Article 642 ET extemporaneous surcharge: 5% of the tax due for each month or fraction of month of delay, capped at 50%, or a minimum based on gross income if no tax is due. Unpaid tax accrues monthly interest at approximately 1.5%. Filing a false or inflated return triggers the Article 647 inexactness penalty of 100% of the tax difference, in addition to criminal prosecution for tax evasion under Law 2277 of 2022.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% final withholding tax on taxable dividends paid or credited to non-resident legal entities and foreign shareholders under Article 408 E.T. This is separate from the 35% corporate income tax borne by the S.A.S.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a lower dividend rate under an applicable tax treaty, the non-resident shareholder must obtain a current Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from its home tax administration, legalize it by apostille or consularization if required, deliver the certificate to the Colombian paying entity, and submit a sworn beneficial-ownership statement before payment. The paying entity must retain the TRC and supporting documents for at least five years and report the dividend payment in the monthly withholding declarations. If statutory 10% withholding was over-collected relative to the treaty rate, the shareholder may request a refund through DIAN using the electronic refund procedure, attaching the TRC, certified corporate existence, and a treaty-benefit analysis.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rates for payments to non-residents: interest on external debt 15%, royalties for intellectual property and know-how 30%, and technical/assistance services 10-15% depending on characterization. Under Colombia's income tax treaties, interest is commonly reduced to 5-10% and royalties to 5-15%, subject to beneficial-ownership and economic substance requirements.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Form 120 are required when gross income or gross assets exceed 92,000 UVT (approximately COP 4.58 billion for tax year 2025) and related-party cross-border transactions exceed 45,000 UVT (approximately COP 2.24 billion). Master File is additionally required when the multinational group achieves consolidated revenue above EUR 750 million, as provided by Colombian transfer pricing regulations.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Colombia does not have a Gulf-style Economic Substance Regulation, but the Law 1819 of 2016 general anti-avoidance rule and Articles 260-1 to 260-11 E.T. require economic reality, business purpose, and substance for intercompany transactions. The e-bike manufacturing S.A.S. must maintain physical premises, production equipment, actual personnel, inventory movement, commercial risk, and decision-making functions in Colombia to support its invoice flows and to defend transfer pricing positions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and False Corporate Returns
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of gross revenue in Form 210, overstatement of costs or deductible expenses, omission of assets, concealment of bank deposits from e-bike sales, or submission of sworn forms with fabricated supplier invoices and fake import declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative sanctions under Articles 642 and 647 E.T.: 100% inexactness penalty on the underpaid tax, monthly moratorium interest, extemporaneous filing surcharges, and automatic disqualification from certain tax benefits. Criminal prosecution under Law 2277 of 2022 and Law 1762 of 2015 carries imprisonment of 48 to 108 months, fines up to 150% of the evaded tax, and public-contracting debarment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and legal representatives who sign false returns are jointly and severally liable for the tax deficiency under Article 794 E.T. During criminal proceedings, courts may order travel bans, asset embargoes, personal passport surrender, and seizure of personal and bank assets under money-laundering and extinction-of-ownership rules.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the S.A.S. as a mere invoice platform: no factory, no inventory, no employees in Colombia, no board meetings, no business risk, and intercompany purchases from a related supplier at inflated margins solely to shift profits from e-bike sales abroad.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DIAN may disregard the entity under the Colombian anti-avoidance rule and Article 42 of Law 1258 of 2008, recharacterize income as belonging to the real economic owner, disallow transfer pricing documentation, and impose a TP penalty computed on the value of related-party transactions. The resulting deficiency carries interest, a penalty of 100% for misstatements, and the loss of treaty or Free Zone benefits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil is pierceable when the S.A.S. is used as an instrument of fraud or tax evasion. Directors and shareholders who caused the shell arrangement are personally liable for the corporate tax debt, and their personal property may be attached; criminal liability for fraudulent tax evasion may also result in imprisonment and travel restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Receiving e-bike cargo payments through unlicensed money transmitters, accepting large unexplained cash deliveries, issuing duplicate commercial invoices to facilitate wire transfers from sanctioned jurisdictions, or knowingly transacting with entities on OFAC or Colombian national lists without filing Suspicious Transaction Reports with the UIAF.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines under Law 526 of 1999 and UIAF rules can reach approximately COP 2.5 billion. Criminal money-laundering liability under Article 323 of Law 599 of 2000 carries imprisonment of 10 to 30 years, fines of not less than 1,300 times the legal minimum monthly wage, and permanent asset forfeiture.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who execute, direct, or tolerate such transactions become criminally co-authors. Courts impose preventive travel bans, freezing orders on personal accounts, and civil restitution; the limited liability structure of the S.A.S. will not protect a director who personally benefited or knowingly orchestrated the illicit flow.
